title: The ommatidium of the lacewing Chrysopa (Neuroptera)
journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B 192: 259-271
why: Cited by Kral and Stelzl 1998 for the ommatidium of a Chrysopa lacewing; the species and whether it gives interommatidial angle, acceptance angle or acuity are not confirmed, because only the reference entry was opened.
